F. P., Extraordinary, 2nd October, 2002]
No. LEGIS.1(12)/98/7278, dated
2-10-2002. The following Ordinance by the Governor of the North-West
Frontier Province is hereby published for general information:---
1. Short title commencement.--(1)
This Ordinance may be called the Institute of Management Sciences Ordinance,
2002.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.
(3) It shall come into force on
such date as Government may, by notification in the official Gazette, specify.

Definitions

No. LEGIS.1(12)/98/7278, dated
2-10-2002. The following Ordinance by the Governor of the North-West
Frontier Province is hereby published for general information:---
2. Definitions.--In this
Ordinance, unless there is anything repugnant in the subject or context,--
(i)
"Academic Committee" means the Academic Committee of the Institute
established under section 12;
(ii)
"Board" means the Board of Governors of the Institute established
under section 14;
(iii)
"Chairman" means the Chairman of the Board;
(iv)
"Controller Semester Examination" means the Controller of Semester
Examinations of the Institute:
(v)
"Controller Finance" means the Controller of Finance of the Institute
appointed under section 9;
(vi)
"Director" means the Director of the Institute appointed under
section 6;
(vii)
"Executive Committee" means the Executive Committee of the Institute
established under section 14;
(viii)
"Government" means the Government of North-West Frontier Province:
(ix)
"Institute" means the Institute of Management Sciences, Peshawar, established
under section 3:
(x)
"member" means a member of the Board;
(xi)
"prescribed" means prescribed by rules made under this Ordinance.
(xii)
"section" means a section of this Ordinance; and
(xiii)
"year" means a calendar year.

Establishment of the Institute

INSTITUTE OF

No. LEGIS.1(12)/98/7278, dated
2-10-2002. The following Ordinance by the Governor of the North-West
Frontier Province is hereby published for general information:---
3. Establishment of the
Institute.--There shall be established an as the Institute of Management
Sciences, at Peshawar, which shall be a body corporate, having perpetual
succession and a common seal with power to acquire and hold property, both
movable and immovable, and shall by the said name sue and be sued.

Powers and functions of the Institute

ORDINANCE XXXVII OF 2002
INSTITUTE OF
MANAGEMENT SCIENCES ORDINANCE, 2002
ORDINANCE XXXVII OF
2002
An Ordinance to
provide for establishment of an Institute of Management Sciences at Peshawar
[Gazette of N.-W.
F. P., Extraordinary, 2nd October, 2002]
No. LEGIS.1(12)/98/7278, dated
2-10-2002. The following Ordinance by the Governor of the North-West
Frontier Province is hereby published for general information:---
4. Powers and functions of the
Institute.--(1) The Institute shall exercise the powers and perform the
functions as under:
(a) to provide
for teaching business administration, public administration, information
technology and related disciplines as it may deem tit, and to make provision of
research, management, development programmes, consultancy and for the advancement
and dissemination of knowledge in such manner as it may determine;
(b) to prescribe
courses of studies, to be conducted by it with the approval of the Academic
Committee;
(c) to conduct
semester examinations and to notify the results; provided that till the
Institute remains affiliated with the University of Peshawar, it will pass on
the final mutts, alongwith relevant record, to the University of Peshawar for
such notification;
(d) to create
posts for teaching; research, training, consultancy, administration and other
related purposes with the approval of the Board;
(e) to appoint
persons against the sanctioned posts;
(f) to establish
centers of learning for the development of teaching and research and to make
such, arrangements for their maintenance, management and administration as it
may determine;
(g) to make'
provisions for research, consultancy and advisory, services and for this
purpose to enter into arrangements with other 'institutions or with public and
private bodies under prescribed conditions:
(h) to promote
cooperation with Government, national and international organizations and
universities in activities falling within the purview of the Institute;
(i) to affiliate
or associate itself with other institutions and establish faculties in Pakistan
or abroad, in accordance with the law for the time being in force in this
behalf for the effective discharge of its functions and responsibilities;
(j) to charge
and receive such fees and other payments as it may determine with the approval
of the Board; and
(k) to do all
such other acts and things, whether incidental, to the powers aforesaid or not,
as may be necessary in order to promote the objectives of the Institute as a
place of education, learning, research and consultancy.
(2) Till such time as the Board
may determine, the Institute shall arrange to get itself affiliated with the
University of Peshawar.

Institute open to all

5. Institute open to all.--The
Institute-shall be opened to persons of either sex of whatever religion race,
creed, colour, who are eligible under the rules and academically qualified for
admission to be courses of study offered by the Institute, and no such, person
shall be denied the privileges of the Institute only on grounds ox sex,
religion, race, creed, or colour.

Director

6. Director.--There shall
be appointed a director by the Board on such terms and conditions and the Board
may determine, initially for a period not exceeding four years; provided that
extension for a further period upto four years may be granted by the Board on
his satisfactory performance, beyond which no further extension shall be
admissible.

The powers and duties of the Director

ORDINANCE XXXVII OF 2002
INSTITUTE OF
MANAGEMENT SCIENCES ORDINANCE, 2002
ORDINANCE XXXVII OF

No. LEGIS.1(12)/98/7278, dated
2-10-2002. The following Ordinance by the Governor of the North-West
Frontier Province is hereby published for general information:---
7. The powers and duties of
the Director.--(1) The Director shall be the principal executive and
academic officer of the Institute and shall ensure that -the provisions of this
Ordinance, the Statutes, the Regulations and the Rules to be framed thereunder,
are faithfully observed and the decisions of the Board are promptly
implemented, in order to promote the general efficiency and good order of the
Institute. He shall have powers necessary for this purpose, including
administrative control over all officers, teachers and other employees of the
Institute.
(2) The Director may, in the
circumstances in which immediate action, in his opinion, is required, take such
action as he may consider necessary, and shall, as soon as possible thereafter,
report to the concerned Committee or, as the case may be, the Authority, for
necessary recommendations to the Board for approval; provided that the power
under this subsection shall be exercised by the Director in cases where it is
absolutely necessary.

Controller Finance

8. Controller Finance.--There
shall be a Controller of Finance to be appointed by the Board on such terms and
conditions as may be determined by it, who shall--
(i) manage the
property, finances and investments of the Institute;
(ii) prepare
annual statement of accounts and annual and revised budget estimates of the
Institute and present them to the Board for approval;
(iii) ensure
that the funds of the Institute are spent for the purpose for which these are
provided; and

Controller of Examinations

9. Controller of
Examinations.--There shall be Controller of Examinations to be appointed by
the Board on such terms and conditions as may be determined by it, who will be
responsible for all matters connected with the examinations and be responsible
for keeping its record properly and shall perform such other duties as may be
prescribed.

Board of Governors

10. Board of Governors.--(1)
There shall be Board of Governors consisting of the following:
(i) Governor of the North-West
Frontier Province.
Chairman
(ii) Minister for Education,
North-West Frontier Province.
Member
(iii) Chief Secretary to
Government, North-West Frontier Province.
Member
(iv) Vice Chancellor,
University of Peshawar.
Member
(v) Secretary to Government,
Finance Department.
Member
(vi) Secretary to Government,
Higher Education, Sports, Archives and Libraries Department.
Memebr
(vii) a nominee of the Higher
Education Commission not below BPS-20.
Member
(viii) a representative of
Sarhad Chamber of Commerce and Industry, Peshawar.
Member
(ix) a representative of
Institute of Bankers in Pakistan.
Member
(x) a nominee of the Securities
and Exchange Commission not below the rank of a member.
Members
(xi) representative of Ghulam
Ishaq Khan Institute of Engineering Sciences, Topi.
Member
(xii) two prominent .business
executives of the North-West Frontier Province to be nominated by the Board
of Governors.
Member
(xiii) Rector of the Lahore
University of Management Sciences or his nominee.
Member
(xiv) Director, Institute of Business Administration
Karachi, or his nominee.
Member
(xv) one eminent person in the
field of business.
Member
(xvi) one member of the
registered graduates of the Institute elected from amongst themselves.
Member
(xvii) Director of the Institute.
Member-cum -Secretary
(2) The members, other than
ex-officio members, shall hold office for three years commencing from the date
of appointment.
(3) A member, other than
ex-officio member, shall cease to hold office, if he does not attend three
consecutive meetings of the Board without a valid reason.
(4) The meetings of, the Board
shall be presided over by the Chairman or in his absence by one of the members
to be nominated by the Chairman.
(5) The Board shall meet at least
once a year on the dates to be fixed with the approval of the Chairman.
(6) The quorum for a meeting of
the Board shall be one half of the total number of members, a fraction being
counted as one.
(7) The decisions of the Board
shall be expressed in terms of the views of the majority of the members present
and in case of tie, the person presiding the meeting shall exercise a second or
casting vote.

Power and functions of the Board

ORDINANCE XXXVII OF 2002
INSTITUTE OF
MANAGEMENT SCIENCES ORDINANCE, 2002
ORDINANCE XXXVII OF

An Ordinance to

No. LEGIS.1(12)/98/7278, dated
2-10-2002. The following Ordinance by the Governor of the North-West
Frontier Province is hereby published for general information:---
11. Power and functions of the
Board.--(1) The Board shall be the policy formulation and executive body of
the Institute and shall, subject to the provisions of this Ordinance and the
rules made thereunder, exercise general supervision over the affairs of the
Institute.
(2) In particular and without
prejudice to the generality of the forgoing provisions, the Board shall have
the powers--
(i) to exercise
overall control over the Institute:
(ii) to appoint
the teachers and other officers/staff of the Institute and to determine the
terms and conditions of their services, including their qualification,
experience and eligibility for appointment;
(iii) to cause
proper books of accounts to be kept for all sums of money received from all
sources and expended by the Institute and for assets and liabilities of the
Institute;
(iv) to consider
and approve the budget estimates, annual research programmes, annual report and
audited statements of accounts of the Institute;
(v) to
re-appropriate funds from .one major head of expenditure to another;
(vi) to enter
into, vary, carry out and cancel contracts on behalf of the Institute;
(vii) to
institute professorships, lectureships and other administrative posts and to
appoint persons thereto on the recommendation of the Selection Committee;
(viii) to
receive and manage property, grants, bequests, trust, gifts, donations
endowments and other contribution made to the Institute, and to invest, for the
cause of the Institute, any fund representing such property, grants, bequests,
trusts, gifts, donations endowments or contributions in the prescribed manner;
(ix) to fix
fees/charges, etc., of the various courses and programmes;
(x) to delegate
any of its powers to the Director or a Committee constituted under this
Ordinance, except the power of approval of budgetary estimates;
(xi) to approve
appointments of members of various Committees established under this Ordinance;
(xii) to appoint
auditor for the annual audit of the accounts of the Institute;
(xiii) to
suspend, punish and remove from service, in the prescribed manner, employees of
the Institute;
(xiv) to frame
rules, as are necessary for carrying out the purpose of this Ordinance; and
(xv) to
regulate, determine and administer all other matters concerning the Institute
and to this end exercise all other powers in this behalf not specifically
mentioned in this Ordinance.

Academic Committee

12. Academic Committee.--(1)
There shall be an Academic Committee consisting of--
(i) the Director;
Chairman
(ii) all professors of the
Institute (including professor emeritus);
Member
(iii) three Associate
Professors of the Institute to be nominated by the Board on the
recommendation of the Director for a period of three years;
Member
(iv) one eminent business man
to be nominated by the Chairman of the Board of Governors for a period of
three years;
Member
(v) one Assistant Professor of
the Institute to be nominated by the Board on the recommendation of the
Director for three years; and
Member
(vi) two experts in Business
Administration/ Computer Science/related disciplines to be nominated by the
Board on the recommendation of the Director for three years.
Member
(2) The Academic Committee shall
be responsible for all academic matters including courses, syllabi examinations
degrees, diplomas and certificates and matters connected therewith.
(3) The meetings of the Academic
Committee shall be held as frequently as possible but not less than twice a
year.
(4) The quorum of a meeting of
the Academic Committee shall be one half of the total members.

Selection Committee

13. Selection Committee.--(1)
There shall be a Selection Committee comprising of the following:
(i) The Director;
Chairman
(ii) the Chairman or la nominee
of the North-West Frontier Province Public Service Commission.
Member
(iii) a representative of the
Higher Education Department not below the rank of Deputy Secretary.
Member
(iv) a representative of the
Establishment Department not below the rank of Deputy Secretary.
Member
(v) one eminent business man to
be nominated by the Chairman of the Board of Governors for three years; and
Member
(vi) two experts in the
relevant field of studies to be nominated by the Board for three years.
Members
(2) All appointments to posts in the Institute shall be made by
the Board on the recommendation of the Selection Committee.
(3) Five members shall form the
quorum for a meeting of the Selection Committee.

Executive Committee

14. Executive Committee.--(1)
There shall be an Executive Committee consisting of--
(i) the
Director;
(ii) all professors
of the Institute ('excluding professor emeritus); .
(iii) a
representative of the Higher Education Department not below the rank of Deputy
Secretary;
(iv) a
representative of the Establishment Department not below the rank of Deputy
Secretary;
(v) a
representative -of the Finance Department, not below the rank of Deputy
Secretary:
(vi) Controller
of Finance; and
(vii) one expert
in the Business Administration/Computer Science to be nominated by the Board on
the recommendation of the Director for three years.
(2) The Executive Committee will
be responsible for all matters involving general administration and finances to
be decided in emergency and make recommendations to the Board.
(3) The meeting of Executive
Committee shall be held as frequently as needed.

Institute Fund

ORDINANCE XXXVII OF 2002
INSTITUTE OF
MANAGEMENT SCIENCES ORDINANCE, 2002
ORDINANCE XXXVII OF

F. P., Extraordinary, 2nd October, 2002]
No. LEGIS.1(12)/98/7278, dated
2-10-2002. The following Ordinance by the Governor of the North-West
Frontier Province is hereby published for general information:---
15. Institute Fund.--(1)
The institute shall have a Fund to which shall be credited all grants made by
Government, including Federal Government, or contributions and donations made
by individuals local bodies organizations or agencies and income from fees
received, sale proceeds and royalties on publications and such other sources as
may be approved by the Board.
(2) No expenditure shall be made
from the Funds unless a bill for its payment has been audited by the Audit
Officer of the Institute, in accordance with the prescribed manner.
(3) The accounts of the Institute
shall be maintained in such form and manner as may be prescribed and shall be
audited once a year by a qualified Chartered. Accountant appointed by the
Board.
(4) The annual statement of
accounts and audit report thereon shall be submitted by the auditor for
consideration of the Board.
(5) The Institute shall furnish
to Government each year a report on annual audited accounts, report on the
activities of the Institute during the preceding year by 30th September of the
following year and such information rafting to its activities as may be asked
for by Government.

Saving

16. Saving.--(1)
Everything done, actions taken, obligations or liabilities incurred, rights and
assets acquired, persons appointed or authorized, jurisdictions or powers
conferred, endowments, bequests funds or trusts created, donations or grants
made, privileges granted under or in pursuance of the Education Department
Notification No. SO(UE)1-47/98, dated the 12th June, 1999, shall be deemed to
have been done taken, incurred, acquired, appointed or authorised, conferred,
created, made and granted under this Ordinance and shall continue, if not
inconsistent to this Ordinance, unless altered, amended or done away with.

Removal of difficulties

17. Removal of difficulties.--If
any difficulty arises in giving effect to any of the provisions of this
Ordinance, the Chairman may, on the recommendations of the Board, give such
direction, not inconsistent with any of the provisions of this Ordinance, as he
may consider necessary for the removal of such difficulty.
